checklist_item.title: Is LeafNode rest_of_key slice correct (key[level:])?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify LeafNode rest_of_key equals key[level:]. 2. Check for off-by-one in slice. 3. Test proof verification with generated LeafNodes. 4. Test at various tree depths.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is Address conversion correct in _prepare_trie?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify Address(preimage) conversion. 2. Check for truncation or extension of bytes. 3. Test with various preimage lengths. 4. Verify get_storage_root receives correct address.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-0050, Trust Boundary: tb-002. Bug bounty eligible.

checklist_item.title: Can gossip validation produce non-deterministic outcomes for the same sidecar input?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Trace all execution paths through the gossip validation pipeline. 2. Verify deterministic path selection from q_init to q_final. 3. Check for sources of non-determinism (race conditions, mutable state, time-dependent checks, RNG usage, floating-point precision). 4. Construct adversarial sidecars to trigger divergent outcomes. 5. Review validation caching for consistency.
